To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

Piwil2 expression was significantly higher in the cancerous breast tissues compared to noncancerous tissues, and that piR-932 expression was significantly lower in the cancerous compared to noncancersous breast tissues.
piR-932 is downregulated in breast cancer and that the expression of piR-932 and Piwil2 is associated with breast cancer prognosis.
piR-932 is expressed in breast cancer cells and is associated with poor prognosis, and that Piwil2 is expressed in the majority of breast cancers and is associated with good prognosis.

the role of piRNA in cancer and the expression of Piwil2 and PiR-932 in BC.
the expression of stem cell marker Piwil2 in the breast cancer tissue.
the role of the Piwil2 gene in breast cancer.

the expression of Piwil2 and the piR-932 are significantly up-regulated in breast cancer.
the expression of piRNA cluster Piwil2 and its piR-932 is associated with a worse clinical outcome in breast cancer patients.
the expression of Piwil2 and the piR-932 expression are not related to the clinical and histopathological parameters of breast cancer.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the expression of Piwil2 and its associated piRNA, piR-932, in breast cancer tissues was significantly higher compared to normal breast tissues.
the expression of piR-932 is downregulated in breast cancers and the downregulation of piR- 932 is associated with poor prognosis.
the Piwil2 gene is expressed at higher levels in breast cancer than in normal tissues.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the expression of Piwil2 is significantly associated with poor overall and disease-free survival of breast cancer.
piR-932 may serve as a novel prognostic marker for breast cancer.
